Once the instance is set up for the customer, disprz can generate & share this instance specific token with the customer for their further development to perform Create / Read / Update / Delete (CRUD) operations with the disprz data. **Token Parameter Key**: Learntron-Api-Token **Token Parameter Value**: < _Generated Token for customer_ > ## **Disprz API - Usage** Frequently used disprz API’s are logically grouped under 3 sections. User - For customers who just want to manage User Profile between the disprz and their HRMS/HRIS system can use the API’s under ‘User Management’ section. - For customers who need to pull their user enrolled modules details, can be accessed via the API’s  under the ‘Modules’ section. - To access users points redemption, customers can use APIs from the ‘Redemption’ section. - To relate roles with users, APIs under ‘Skill’ can be used. - To pull the skills assessment of users, APIs under ‘Skills Assessment’ section. Content - For customers who want to access the disprzs’ content metadata to show in their LMS system can use the API’s under ‘Learning Objects’ section. Analytics - To fetch content progress & completion details against users can be pulled using the APIs under ‘Analytics’ section. # **Please follow the below while invoking the APIs** 1. Implement a daily incremental data extraction process. 2. Limit each data retrieval operation to a maximum of 1000 records. 3. Prepare for future data retrieval with a 24-hour delay.( in the near future the data will be 24hr delayed data) 4. Execute sequential iterations, initiating subsequent hits after receiving responses from previous ones. 5. Employ a retry mechanism with a 2-second delay when needed. The APIs will be rate limited in the near future and the cost would be according to the usage in a few months time. # **1\. Analytics** Below API’s are grouped together as they are used to fetch Learners Analytics with different filter and grouping criteria. ## **1.1 Learner Analytics** This API is to fetch learner's analytics either in bulk or individually depending on the filter criteria passed in the request. **Request URL:** **GET** [**https://disprzexternalapi.disprz.com/api/Analytics/GetLearnerAnalytics**](https://disprzexternalapi.disprz.com/api/Analytics/GetLearnerAnalytics "https://disprzexternalapi.disprz.com/api/Analytics/GetLearnerAnalytics") Header: Key: Learntron-Api-Token Value: Body raw (JSON): **Request (Query Params)** **These parameters can be used to filter the necessary data.** **Note: ‘offset’ and ‘fetchcount’ are the mandatory fields to get a valid response.** | | | | | --- | --- | --- | | **Key** | **Data Type** | **Comments** | | offset | number | Offset defines the record starting position.  Offset value generally starts from 0 and increments at each iteration summing up the fetchcount value.
Offset = offset + fetchCount | | fetchCount | number | Number of  records per request. Suggested max value to be 1000 | | fieldID | string | Filter based on Disprz UDF IDs to be constructed as eg, &fieldID=1&fieldID=3 when multiple ids to be passed | | fieldValue | string | Filter based on UDF Values that corresponds to the above field id | | managerId | string | filter by manager id. This can be either the employee id of the manager of the email id. Depending on the data stored by the client | | managerType Id | string | filter by manager type id when there are multiple manager types configured. This can be obtained from disprz spocs | | fetchNestedReportees | boolean | When set to true, the response contains the  nested reportees data | | userId | string | Filter based on the Disprz unique identifier of the user. | | firstName | string | filter by first name | | lastName | string | filter by last name | | userName | string | filter based on the unique identifier of the user based on the configuration. Can be either employee id or email id | | email | string | filter by email | | userContexts | string | Filter based on the roles defined on the platform | | userStatus | number | 1 - active, 2 - inactive, 3- locked | | programId | string | filter by Disprz program id | | skillId | string | filter by Disprz skill id | | moduleId | string | Filter by disprz module id can be constructed for multiple ids. Refer to the field id above. | | moduleType | string | Filter based on the module types.
1-Self Paced, 2-Live Modules, 3-MOOC, 4-Classroom | | partnerId | string | filter by partner id (MOOC) Disprz will share on demand | | moduleFromDate | date | User’s From enrolled date | | moduleToDate | date | User’s To enrolled date | | isComplete | boolean | True - To get the completed modules | | inProgress | boolean | True - To get the inProgress modules | | notStarted | boolean | True - To get the NotStarted modules | | fromTimePeriod | dateTime | To get records from date | | toTimePeriod | dateTime | To get records to date | | datePeriodType | TimePeriod | 1 = OnlyCompletions 2 = AccessedOn 3 = EnrolledOn | | timezoneOffsetInMins | number | Response Defaults to IST or -330 for IST
